description: This Java class 'LwM2mCredentialsSecurityInfoValidator' handles validation and creation of security information for LwM2M device credentials, supporting different security modes (NO_SEC, PSK, RPK, X509) within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: LwM2mCredentialsSecurityInfoValidator
classes.description: A validator class for creating and retrieving security info based on device credentials and security modes in LwM2M protocol.

methods.name: getEndpointSecurityInfoByCredentialsId
methods.description: Retrieves security info for a device endpoint based on credentials ID and server type, with asynchronous processing and timeout handling.

methods.name: createSecurityInfo
methods.description: Creates security info object based on credentials message and server type, supporting different security modes.

methods.name: createClientSecurityInfoNoSec
methods.description: Sets security info to no security mode.

methods.name: createClientSecurityInfoPSK
methods.description: Creates PSK security info using device credentials.

methods.name: createClientSecurityInfoRPK
methods.description: Creates RPK security info using device credentials.
